headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 16, 2026**
article:
Arizona Diamondbacks left fielder Tommy Troy has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a sprained right AC joint, effective retroactive to July 12, 2026. The Brewers made a significant trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Lance McCullers Jr. from the Astros in exchange for outfielder Jadyn Fielder and two other players.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, affecting their teams' lineups. Rob Zastryzny of the Brewers has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a left trapezius strain. Drew Millas of the Nationals has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left index finger fracture. Nick Mears of the Royals has been transferred from the 15-day to the 60-day injured list with a right shoulder impingement. Keegan Akin of the Orioles has been transferred from the 15-day to the 60-day injured list with left elbow discomfort.

The Brewers have made two trades, acquiring Lance McCullers Jr. and Colton Gordon from the Astros in exchange for outfielder Jadyn Fielder. The Astros have lost McCullers Jr. and Gordon, while the Brewers have gained two new pitchers. The Brewers also traded Easton McGee to the Royals for cash. The Tigers have traded Jahmai Jones to the Red Sox for a player to be named later.

top_news.title: **Brewers Acquire Lance McCullers Jr. in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have acquired right-handed pitcher Lance McCullers Jr. in a trade with the Houston Astros. McCullers Jr. joins the Brewers along with left-handed pitcher Colton Gordon in exchange for outfielder Jadyn Fielder.
